title: Beat
description: A node in the campaign BeatGraph produced by ingestion and approved on the Prep Bench. The Director navigates these; off-script play creates ad-hoc beats that link back into the graph.

entry_conditions.description: Predicates over engine state / revealed facts, e.g. 'party.location == loc.keep', 'clock.night >= 3'.

mandatory_first.description: E.g. the module requires one specific encounter before the hub opens.

narration_brief_seed.description: Partial NarrationBrief the Director starts from (tone, hints, constraints).

manifest_seed.description: Partial VisibleManifest for the beat's establishing image; pre-rendered at prep.

entities.description: Entity-card ids in play this beat.

secrets.description: Fact ids that are hidden at beat entry. Drives the per-episode red-team checklist and the post-slice leak audit.

clock.description: Tension clocks. Each tick fires its cue bundle — SFX + screen widget + music step — as pure data.

xp_rules.description: Original paraphrase of award conditions, machine-checkable where possible.

rules_notes.description: 2014→2024 patches for this beat (e.g. surprise handling).

source_ref.description: Pack page/section pointer for the Prep Bench. Reference only.

approved.description: Set only by a human on the Prep Bench. Unapproved beats never enter a live session.
